scope: Source inventory diagnostics, promotion provenance and loader/watcher seams; not an exhaustive repository audit

findings.title: JSON readability was reported as model promotion
findings.mechanism: Arbitrary JSON Value was legible=true and CLI counted it as promoted, even when the serving structural validator rejects it.
findings.change: Preserve old fields; add optional structural verdict and reason from NanoForest::from_data on the hashed source buffer; legacy manifests remain unevaluated. CLI reports inventory, readability and structure separately.
findings.limits: No certification of predictive skill, promotion, feature semantics or effective activation. No cache writes by scanner.

findings.title: Promotion holdout helpers disconnected from executable route
findings.mechanism: Observed main does not parse test-in; gate_ok depends on selection only. Presence of separately tested helpers does not gate promotion.
findings.limits: GLM training metrics were reported, not rerun. Historical trainer binary identity unverified. Claude repairs are not duplicated.

findings.title: JSON source hash is not effective predictor identity
findings.mechanism: Binary cache chosen by mtime may contain a different valid predictor from the hashed JSON. No source-hash binding checked.
findings.limits: Synthetic witness of an open provenance gap, not proof of a live BTC incident or a closed defect. Loader unchanged.

findings.title: Watcher records modification before load succeeds
findings.mechanism: Failed load can consume the new timestamp; unchanged file is not retried. In-place publication permits partial-read windows.
findings.limits: Race not exercised on the live process; no process changes performed.

findings.title: Filename coverage and startup log overstate loaded availability
findings.mechanism: Coverage checks names and startup log ignores load result; actual decision path checks the global model map.
findings.limits: MR-01 does not fix host coverage/logging or relax any gate.

findings.title: Legacy sigmoid base loses regression units
findings.mechanism: Every source gets sigmoid(init_score), including regression objectives whose intercept is a raw conditional target mean.
findings.change: Clarify existing metadata without changing schema meaning or serving.
findings.limits: No evidence that this manifest field drives live regression sizing. Typed objective/unit/horizon metadata remains pending.
